title: 2026-10-28 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving (Ningbo Global Innovation Center, CPU 不再只是 KV 的溢出仓库，而是第二个可独立调度的解码引擎。)、Prefetch-Steered Routing: Deterministic Cache-Aware Expert Selection for Offloaded Mixture-of-Experts Decoding (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), 让预取只影响延迟、不影响路由决策，才能既快又测得准。)、BellowsKV: One Latent for Many Layers, Expanded on Demand (Rice University, 跨层共享的应该是隐状态，而不是 KV 本身。)、INTRA: Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention (New York University, 稀疏注意力不必在单层内覆盖所有 token 对，跨层中继同样能保住长程通信。)

highlights.name: DualPace
highlights.note: CPU 成为独立调度的解码引擎，吞吐比 NEO 高 6.9%–43.2%

highlights.name: BellowsKV
highlights.note: 跨层共享隐状态潜变量，13–14 倍压缩仍保留 97%–98% 精度

highlights.name: RSI Arena
highlights.note: 十个前沿模型自主后训练，最强中位填补 76% 能力差距
